summary: Sprott Inc. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release announcing the date for its 2026 first quarter results webcast. The release, dated April 29, 2026, states results will be issued on May 6, 2026, followed by an earnings webcast at 10:00 a.m. ET hosted by the CEO, CFO, and asset management CEO. This is a routine earnings reminder with no special-situation terms, structural mechanics, or advisory involvement. There is no transaction, activist campaign, strategic review, or other corporate event requiring risk-arb analysis.
